objective: Improve future BUKLOD Main render-error investigations with classified, privacy-safe client cause/origin fingerprints and RLS-authorized per-case BSOC health evidence; no guessing or OTA auto-resolution.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production Android 1.3.6 reported RENDER_3E577D35 on 2026-11-18 at 14:05:34 UTC on route scope. Existing health event retained only hash/route, no exact exception, and linked BSOC case had no verified release association. Main source 404c87e55c62a88c95c7389ac8665f237149702a read first. Exact EAS served OTA and user-specific running update remain unverified; no production write authorized.
chosenApproach: Preserve the legacy RENDER error signature and health RPC schema while adding fixed-code on-device error pattern classification and source-area hints only when an original source frame is present. Attach codes through existing correlation_key. Display per-case health rows solely through existing RLS-protected bsoc_health_events SELECT with case ID, bound 5 rows and cancellation on switching case/account. Never include raw exception messages, stack traces or personal identifiers. Only DEV draft; no OTA.
selectionRationale: Zero backend schema/auth changes and no native dependencies. Cannot safely infer exact source from a hashed signature or minified Hermes stack. RLS controls observational access; original error code remains comparable across releases.
alternativeApproaches: Transmit raw JavaScript error stacks to BSOC: rejected due to privacy and secrets risk.
Decode old error hashes as root cause: impossible without original exception payload.
Add new native crash SDK or modify BSOC RLS: rejected as unnecessary release/security expansion for initial fix.
preserveBehaviors: Authenticated health-event RPC signature, idempotent reporting and dedupe remain unchanged.
BSOC cases, replies, notifications, attachments and staff permission gates unchanged.
No raw exception text/stack/path/PII in telemetry; only fixed small code categories.
Wall, Connect, navigation performance, first-view AdMob, media and other production features untouched.
Season 2 December 6 production embargo, release gates, backend and native runtime remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Prove fixed taxonomy for missing data, type error, React hook/render loops and unknown cause without copying raw messages or stacks.
Confirm same legacy hashed error signature, RLS-only query for selected case, bounded read, and reset on case/account switch.
Source TypeScript and relevant BUKLOD BSOC, navigation, protected-feature and AdMob smoke gates pass before staging promotion.
No claim of root cause or OTA resolution until runtime stack/source mapping and exact served bundle/device evidence are available.
